title: Semantic and Structural Analysis of Implicit Biases in Large Language Models: An Interpretable Approach
findings: The proposed method achieved a detection accuracy of 81% for religious stereotypes. This performance was slightly lower than for gender (85%) and profession (83%) stereotypes, which the authors suggest is due to the greater complexity, subtlety, and cultural embedding of religious biases.
